title: The Great Divide Cigarette Smoke Vinyl
body_html:
The Great Divide, the highly anticipated new album from 2x Grammy Nominee Noah Kahan.

"From a long silence forms a divide, a great expanse demanding attention. I stare across it. I see old friends, my father, my mother, my siblings, my younger self, the great state of Vermont. I want to scream these feelings, to gesticulate wildly at the figures on the other side, but my voice has grown hoarse and muted after years of climbing a ladder towards the wild, spiraling dreams that have materialized in front of me. Instead, I wrote them down next to a piano in Nashville, next to a pond in Guilford Vermont, in a legendary studio in upstate New York, on a farm with a firetower in Only, Tennessee. The songs are the words I would say if I could. They are the fears I dance with in the moments before I drift off to sleep. The music here is my best attempt to delve deeper into the people, places, and feelings that have made me who I am. I am grateful for all of it, for all of you, for listening to them, if you choose to do so."

Produced by Stick Season collaborator Gabe Simon as well as new collaborator Aaron Dessner

Tracklist:

Side A:

1. End of August
2. Doors
3. American Cars
4. Downfall

Side B:
5. Paid Time Off
6. The Great Divide
7. Haircut
8. Willing and Able
9. Dashboard

Side C:
10. 23
11. Porch Light
12. Deny Deny Deny
13. Headed North

Side D:
14. We Go Way Back
15. Spoiled
16. All Them Horses
17. Dan
 

Please note that each vinyl is unique, and the colors may appear slightly different from the image displayed.

title: Stick Season CD
body_html:
Noah Kahan - "Stick Season" - Following the release of his sophomore album, Noah continued to write and record, unlocking a new level of himself as an artist and songwriter. Rife with fluttering guitar melodies, inviting vocals, and homey imagery of the Northeast on the verge of changing seasons, it represents a massive turning point for him. 


Track List:

1. Northern Attitude
2. Stick Season
3. All My Love
4. She Calls Me Back
5. Come Over
6. New Perspective
7. Everywhere Everything
8. Orange Juice
9. Strawberry Wine
10. Growing Sideways
11. Halloween
12. Homesick
13. Still
14. The View Between Villages
